title: Expansion, then rest
prompt: It is 13:20 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The big move happened this morning. Look at what price has been doing since, and whether there is anything new to act on.

whyNot.label: fading the high
whyNot.why: Price is sitting at the high of an expansion, not rejecting from it. Nothing has swept the range or broken structure down; a short here is a guess.

whyNot.label: buying the break of the range
whyNot.why: The range is tight and overlapping. Breaks of a rest inside a finished move often fail, and there's no sell-side liquidity taken to buy from.

reference.summary: A full morning expansion, then two and a half hours of tight, overlapping candles at the high. The setup was in the morning; nothing in this range is one. No trade.

bias.why: Higher highs and higher lows on the Daily and 4H. The rest at the high doesn't change that and doesn't offer an entry.

decision.why: Consolidation after an expansion with nothing swept: no trade, or wait for a real sweep and displacement.

draw.why: Buy-side liquidity above remains the pull; nothing is being traded toward it.

next_objective.why: Price reached none of the pools in view (the previous day's range, the nearest swings, the nearest gap) and stayed inside a narrow range. With no pool drawing it, "no clear objective" was the read that held up.

annotations.label: Top of the rest 23,611.75
annotations.why: Equal-looking highs in a tight rest look like liquidity. Taking them tells you nothing in a market that isn't trending.
annotations.whyNot: Internal liquidity inside a consolidation isn't a draw.

annotations.label: Bottom of the rest 23,584
annotations.why: The other edge of the rest.

annotations.label: The morning's displacement FVG
annotations.why: Where the trade was. Far below now, and not a place to trade from at this price.

annotations.label: 5m FVG on the way up
annotations.why: A gap inside the move that's done.

confluences.label: Two and a half hours of tight, overlapping candles
The morning's setup played out already
Daily and 4H trending up
confluences.why: Bias is intact and offers no entry.

confluences.label: Highs and lows of the rest as liquidity
confluences.why: Internal liquidity in a consolidation isn't a draw.

confluences.label: "It has to do something"
confluences.why: It doesn't have to do anything for you.

lookFor: A setup that already happened isn't a setup you missed: it's finished. Look for the next one.
Time spent resting at a high is information. It says nothing is being taken.

provenance.note: Constructed price path, not market history.
